dry: Import enrolments, identifiers or visits for existing people | Owners and supervisors · dry run first | For people already in Saha, in teams you belong to and supervise. Up to 100 rows and 16,000 bytes. The dry run checks each row; only accepted rows are applied, each record gets a revision, and the batch is audited with its counts. Visits (clinical content) are imported only as read-only history for owners and clinicians; there is no batch reversal. | What to import | Programme enrolments | External identifiers | Historical visits (clinical content) | Columns: person,visit_date,source_system,systolic,diastolic,bp_unit,bp_source,weight,weight_unit,weight_source,temperature,temperature_unit,temperature_source,gestation,gestation_unit,gestation_source,cough_duration,cough_unit,cough_source,override_reason,notes. one row per visit; person is a Saha record id or issuer:value in your care teams; visit_date is YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM and not in the future; every measurement states its unit (weight kg or lb, temperature degC or degF, gestation weeks, cough days or weeks, blood pressure mmHg) and its source (measured or reported); a value outside the placeholder expected range needs override_reason of at least 10 characters, and one beyond the confirmation range is not imported.
